title: Crypto Trends for 2025: Stablecoins, App Stores, UX, and More

reader_summary.headline: So far in our four-part 2025 Big Ideas series, you've heard from teams all over A16C.
reader_summary.overview: So far in our four-part 2025 Big Ideas series, you've heard from teams all over A16C, from American Dynamism to Healthcare, to FinTech, and more. But one team you haven't heard from yet, A16Z Crypto, and that's because we have an entire episode dedicated to their 14 big ideas for 2025. After such a banner year, where among other things, Bitcoin hit all-time highs above $100,000.

thesis: The episode introduces a series of 14 Web3 trends for 2025, with the first idea arguing that stablecoins have achieved product-market fit and will be adopted by margin-sensitive local businesses like coffee shops to recapture fees currently paid to credit card networks. The second idea posits that crypto is developing its own app stores and discovery mechanisms because traditional app stores like Apple's and Google's are inconsistent, confusing, and enforce restrictive in-app purchase policies.
